justification: Local YARA scanning with the YARA Forge rule packages for yara_scan (P272 c1, opt-in). Optional: without it yara_scan reports UNAVAILABLE 'package' ('pip install v3lum[yara]').
notes: Batch p2-G12-1. yara-python 4.5.4 ships wheels for CPython 3.9-3.13 only (none for 3.14/3.15, macOS < 14 or Windows arm64; PyPI 2026-11-26): there the module stays UNAVAILABLE. Rules are compiled locally from source only, never loaded compiled from the network; rule packs are runtime downloads, never bundled (A6).
